marking.appearance_status: TI lists 75453B as the package marking. Typeface, placement, logos and variable lot/date details are illustrative.

recipe.appearance_status: Illustrative KiCad SOIC-8 model; TI D0008A drawing specifies 1.75 mm maximum height. Inspect pin-one and text orientation. Catalogue source does not specify height.

studio.note: Electronics adaptation of the screw product studio: three softboxes, orthographic framing, neutral floor and filmic highlights. Does not claim identical Blender AgX colour management.
